title: Size bound for the layered circuit
statement: Let $C$ be a DAG circuit on $n$ inputs whose gates have distinct arguments and whose NOT gates each have exactly one argument. The size of the associated layered circuit is at most $(|C.\mathrm{gates}|+1)(\mathrm{size}(C)+1)$, where $\mathrm{size}(C)=n+|C.\mathrm{gates}|$.
hypotheses_covered: C is a DAG circuit on n inputs
Every NOT gate has exactly one argument
